title: Restricted Fourier weight observation average
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, let $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be a finite set, let $S\subseteq J$, and fix a sign assignment $z$ on the coordinates outside $J$. If $Y,Y'$ are independent uniform sign assignments on $J$, then the expected product of $f$ evaluated at the combined assignments $(Y,z)$ and $(Y',z)$, multiplied by the corresponding monomial $\chi_S(Y)\chi_S(Y')$, equals the square of the Fourier coefficient of the restriction of $f$ at $S$ with outside assignment $z$.
hypotheses_covered: Fixed sign assignment $z$ on coordinates outside $J$
